item.value: Bench triage verdict: 116 SHIP / 42 EXCLUDE / 21 UNSURE (179 files). EXCLUDE = all v1-v7 ON-vs-OFF runs (report/results/run-* v1..v7), 5 contaminated specs, 2 shipped oracle tests, SPIKE.md. SHIP = heldout/ tree (~100 files), temporal/, retrieval/, report-phase1.md, frequency docs, context-gate-eval.js, wincase-c set reframed as invalidation postmortem. Full table: scratch/competitive/D5-bench-triage.md

Public claims that SURVIVE the v1-v7 invalidation: held-out causal wins (0/10->8.75/10, 0/8->8/8, zero variance, rigging-guarded), temporal as-of 1.0 vs 0.6 recall@5, retrieval scorecard 0.91/0.82, winnable slice ~23% (Phase 0a classification + Phase 1 held-out, no contaminated runs), 3-condition boundary (with condition-1 evidence weakened). Claims that FALL: cost parity 1.63x->1.03x (v2/v3), over-deliberation tax ~2x (v7), v5 1.29x over-work, '8 nulls + 2 wins' framing, regret-0 ~690k tok-eq gate eval.

Context-gate calibration set IS tainted: all 11 'needs_context=NO' labels in context-gate-eval.md derive from contaminated v2-v7 reports, and the oracle leak biases labels toward NO (cold arms read the answer key, so OFF never underperformed). 4 of 5 TNs in the held-out confusion matrix are also v1-v7-derived. Gate CODE/rule ships; regret-0 and 690k-avoided numbers do not. Cheap fix, no new agent runs: re-run bench/context-gate-eval.js against existing clean held-out labels (Phase 1's 4 traps + 3 controls, silent-cap, 2 positives).

Contamination ruling corroborated by repo's own artifacts: report-wincase-c.md documents cold solving 3/3 by reading the committed test ('same reason v1-v7 lost'); MEMORY-RAG-FINDINGS.md s4 states every bench v1-v8 shipped its own oracle. Bias direction: leak inflates the cold/OFF arm. Separability note (ruling not disputed): v2/v3 cost mechanics (cost delta = cache_read of payload, work parity) are methodologically orthogonal to the oracle, so the economics claim is rerunnable under the held-out protocol if wanted.

Pre-ship edit queue from triage: (1) MEMORY-RAG-FINDINGS.md rewrite (strike s2-3 v1-v7 numbers, keep s4-10); (2) regenerate context-gate-eval.md on clean labels; (3) competitive-analysis-2026-06.md needs edits at s1 claim 3, s2 weaker-claims v5/v7 row, moat rows 3/5/10 ('measured (economics)' -> 'built'), s5.1, s7; (4) PII scrub 23 SHIP files (/Users/imyu paths): 20 under heldout/ (all specs, results-heldout.*, p1 scripts+results, n2 jsonl+scripts), frequency-phase0a.md, mcp-on.json, report-wincase-c.md; (5) ingest/ + onboard/ (19 files) need separate content review — orthogonal to the ruling.

Reframed receipts narrative drafted (D5-bench-triage.md s4): lead with 'we invalidated our own first seven benchmarks for contamination and shipped the receipts'; what survives is the held-out protocol (prose-spec solve, external grader, cold-must-fail guard) flipping 0/8->8/8, the clean Phase-1 null on pretraining-covered facts, retrieval 0.91 recall@5, temporal 1.0-vs-0.6, and the narrow earned claim: memory pays iff empirical + external + project-local (~23% of note-dependent tasks on our corpus).
